### Global Metadata
A complete 80-second bright and playful midday piece for a small-town vegetable contest at a summer fair, cheerful and a little comic. 108 BPM, F major. Marimba and xylophone melody, pizzicato strings, a bouncy clarinet, bassoon counter-line, light snare, woodblock and triangle. Pure instrumental ensemble piece.

### Vocal Details
None. Instrumental only: marimba and clarinet trade the tune like two friends competing.

### Timed Arrangement
0-12 seconds: pizzicato strings and woodblock set a bouncy groove. 12-36 seconds: marimba melody with light snare. 36-60 seconds: clarinet takes the tune, bassoon adds a comic counter-line. 60-80 seconds: both together, playful and light. Keep tempo, texture and loudness consistent from start to end; no big climax. The piece must play for the full 80 seconds and must not end early, ending cleanly on the tonic so it can loop.
